snippet.title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page: store.steampowered.com/app/4428800/The_Derailed_Devour_the_Harvest/

The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a first-person psychological horror game in the "walking simulator" genre.

A standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

#horror #horrorgame #unrealengine5
